source_full_text: The whole castle was soon aroused, and then everybody wondered at the affair it was soon seen that the bodies were those of the king's great enemies, But how they came to be there and in that condition was a perfect mystery. Then it was noticed that the drinking-horn was empty and the sword gone, While the princess reported that half of her handkerchief and one of her slippers had been taken away.
